name: EZ-Bar Curl
steps: Stand tall holding an EZ bar on the angled grips, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning back to lift the bar
common_mistakes.fix: Lighten the bar and brace your stomach

common_mistakes.mistake: Elbows moving forward at the top
